searchText: Can you remind me why we don't want to have direct penalties for not doing the sync committee duties? 2) Right now there is only an aggregate of all sync committee pubkeys in the state. I assume that's to allow consumers to follow updates consuming less bandwidth. Then a single sync committee member can invalidate the usefulness of that aggregate pubkey by not participating. Is that correct? in both proposals that are currently involved on the topic there will be penalties for not participating
